scope: embedded disk-based KV; synchronous durable acknowledgement; measured process VmRSS budget

primary_comparison_candidates.required_durability: WriteOptions.sync=true; disableWAL=false; one key per API write
primary_comparison_candidates.memory_requirement: Bound memtables, block/index/filter cache and background memory; validate actual VmRSS, not cache capacity alone
primary_comparison_candidates.adapter_status: implemented in benchmarks/baselines/rocksdb; validation uses Ubuntu librocksdb 8.9.1; no uncontended large-scale comparison results yet

primary_comparison_candidates.required_durability: WithSyncWrites(true); one-key transaction; wait for Commit completion
primary_comparison_candidates.memory_requirement: Positive bounded IndexCacheSize; account for memtables, block cache, mappings and Go runtime in actual VmRSS
primary_comparison_candidates.configuration_requirement: Record ValueThreshold: default 1 MiB keeps the 128-byte workload values inside LSM; a separate explicit low-threshold run is needed to test value separation
primary_comparison_candidates.adapter_status: not implemented; no comparison results yet

conditional_comparison_candidate.conditions: Normal synchronous commits; one key per transaction; account for file-backed resident pages; single-writer and mmap-based VmRSS behavior must be reported

parameter_provenance.reference_duration_seconds: 30; consistent with F2 C++ benchmark kRunSeconds, not a borrowed QPS target
parameter_provenance.pressure_key_count_and_memory: SDK demand_load default, 16 million and 256 MiB
parameter_provenance.pressure_duration_seconds: 600; local steady-state window aligned with the contest workload discussion
parameter_provenance.contest_scale_and_duration: 200 million keys shared by both 4/16 GiB tiers; 70%/30% weights; sizes and tiers confirmed by user 2026-10-29; existing local 600-second measurement window retained
parameter_provenance.key_value_sizes: 16..32-byte keys (default 32), fixed 256-byte values; user-confirmed contest requirements; legacy SDK defaults remain reproducible through tests/run_tests.py
parameter_provenance.threads_warmup_repeats: Local methodology: 1/2/4/8 callers, explicit warmup and 3 repetitions; not official contest rules

published_qps_policy: Only same hardware, durability, operation size, batching and VmRSS constraints qualify for direct performance comparison; historical published figures are context only
